probe.unsupported: No issues found. This API type has no automatic connection check.

rules.noAccess: No role grants access. This service is unreachable by any key.
rules.deprecated: Marked deprecated. Migrate consumers off this service.
rules.cannotConnect: Cannot reach this service. Check its host and credentials.

overview.description: Copy a request and run it.
overview.title: Your API is live

serviceType.label: Service Type
serviceType.tooltip: Select the type of service you're adding.

namespace.label: Namespace
namespace.tooltip: Select a namespace used for the API’s URI structure, such as /api/v2/{type}/{namespace}. It should be lowercase and alphanumeric.
namespace.hint: This becomes the URL segment for the generated API, like /api/v2/your-namespace. Use lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores.

label.label: Label
label.tooltip: The display name or label for the service.

description.label: Description
description.tooltip: Write a brief description of the API (optional).

firstTimeGuidance: This is your first API. We'll walk you through the security configuration that protects it.
createSuccessMsg: Service created. Generate its API docs to try it out, or lock it down with a role.

celebration.title: Your first API is live
celebration.subtitle: {{name}} is ready to use
celebration.whatHappened: Here's what just happened in under 1 second:

database.title: Connected to Database
database.description: Established secure connection and analyzed your database schema

endpoints.title: Generated REST API Endpoints
endpoints.description: Created full CRUD operations for all tables with pagination & filtering

security.title: Applied Security Configuration
security.description: Set up role-based access control with your specified permissions

apiKey.title: Generated API Key
apiKey.description: Created a secure API key for authentication

celebration.usageHint: Add the API key to the 'X-DreamFactory-Api-Key' header in your requests

access.title: Who can reach this service
access.description: Every role is a row, every HTTP verb a column. With many roles, only roles that can reach this service are listed; switch to all roles to prove one has none. Green is full access, amber is filtered, muted is none. Derived live from the role graph.
access.hint: Agents and API keys inherit these grants through their role. Click any granted cell to see exactly what that role can reach across the platform.

dialog.title: {{verb}} on {{service}}
dialog.hint: This is everything the role reaches, not just this service. Grants marked inherited come from a wildcard rule; explicit grants target one service. Edit the role to change what agents and keys under it can touch.

access.summary: {{granted}} of {{total}} roles can reach this service

pipeline.title: The request pipeline
pipeline.description: The ordered chain every request runs before it reaches your data. Each step deep-links to the config that governs it.
pipeline.hint: Derived live from keys, roles, and limits. Open steps are policies you have not set yet.

curlImport.buttonHint: Prefill the base URL, parameters and headers from a cURL command.
curlImport.title: Import from cURL
curlImport.hint: Paste a cURL command. The URL, query parameters, headers and supported CURL options are mapped onto this service's configuration. Nothing is saved until you save the service.

backendAuth.title: Backend Authentication
backendAuth.description: DreamFactory gets an OAuth2 bearer token with the client credentials grant and sends it on every request to the remote API. It caches the token and renews it. API clients never see these credentials.
backendAuth.hint: Set a token URL, a client ID and a client secret to turn this on. Leave the token URL blank to turn it off.
backendAuth.incomplete: A token URL is set. Also fill in: {{fields}}.
backendAuth.saveBlocked: Backend Authentication is incomplete. A token URL is set. Also fill in: {{fields}}.

semantic.title: What agents should know about this data
semantic.description: Business terms, metrics, verified questions and notes for this service. Approved entries reach AI agents inside the MCP data model; drafts and stale entries never do.

empty.title: Teach agents what this data means
empty.description: Add glossary terms, metrics, verified questions and notes so AI agents read your business language instead of guessing from column names. Start by seeding drafts from the descriptions your database already has, or let an AI Connection draft them. Only entries you approve are sent to agents.

delete.title: Delete entry
delete.message: Delete "{{name}}"? Agents stop receiving it immediately if it was approved.

validate.ok: Checked {{checked}} approved entries against the live schema. All still match.
validate.stale: Checked {{checked}} approved entries. {{count}} no longer match the schema and are now stale:

hint.term: A glossary entry: what a business word means here, and optionally which table, column or value it refers to.
hint.metric: A named aggregate. Agents run it with the aggregate_data tool using exactly these arguments.
hint.query: A question you have checked, with the request that answers it. Agents run it with the get_table_data tool.
hint.note: A caveat agents must know before querying: test rows to exclude, a view whose name misleads, a sentinel date. Example: "Rows 122, 123 and 125 in departments are test data; real departments are d001 to d009."

editor.backToDraftNote: Changing the definition sends this entry back to draft; a name or description change keeps its status.
editor.name: Name
editor.descriptionHint: Optional note for admins and agents.
editor.synonymsHint: Press Enter or comma after each synonym.
editor.mapsTo: Maps to a table or column
editor.valueHint: The stored value this term stands for, e.g. shipped.
editor.question: Question
editor.questionHint: Phrase it the way a user would ask it.
editor.fieldsHint: Leave empty to return every field.
editor.filterHint: DreamFactory filter syntax. Use {name} for a value the agent supplies, and declare it below.
editor.relatedHint: Relationships to include with each row.
editor.paramsHint: None. Add one for each {placeholder} in the filter.
editor.undeclared: The filter uses {{names}} but no parameter declares it.
editor.unused: Declared but not used in the filter: {{names}}.
editor.textHint: One or two plain sentences an agent can act on.
editor.severityHint: Warnings go ahead of the metrics; info notes trail the block.
editor.appliesToHint: Optional. Naming tables (and columns) scopes the note: agents whose role cannot see a table never receive it.
editor.examplesHint: Ways a user might ask for this, one per Enter. Helps agents match a question to this entry.
editor.serviceWideHint: Otherwise an entry with no table is shown only to roles that can read every table in this service.

preview.title: What agents see for {{service}}
preview.hint: This is the semantics block MCP get_semantics (and the head of get_data_model) returns for this service. Only approved entries are included.
preview.empty: Nothing yet. Approve an entry and it appears here.

banner.seedOk: Seeded {{created}} draft terms from table and column descriptions, labels and database comments ({{skipped}} already existed). Review and approve the ones that are right.
banner.seedAllExist: Nothing new to seed: all {{skipped}} candidates already exist in the catalog.
banner.seedNone: Nothing to seed: this service has no table or column descriptions, labels or database comments recorded. Draft with AI, or add entries by hand.
banner.draftOk: The model proposed {{proposed}} entries: {{created}} saved as drafts, {{rejected}} rejected by the schema check. Review and approve the ones that are right.
banner.importOk: Import finished: {{created}} created, {{updated}} updated, {{unchanged}} unchanged, {{approved}} approved, {{failed}} failed.
banner.approveAll: Approved {{ok}} of {{total}} drafts. {{failed}} could not be approved; the reason is shown on each row.
banner.approveAllStopped: Stopped after {{done}} of {{total}} drafts: {{ok}} approved, {{failed}} could not be approved. The rest are still drafts.

review.waiting: {{count}} drafts are waiting for review ({{detail}}). Agents receive nothing until they are approved.
review.reviewing: Reviewing {{count}} drafts from seeding, AI and imports. Approve the ones that are right, edit or delete the rest.

draft.title: Draft with AI
draft.hint: The model reads this service’s condensed data model (tables, columns and counts, plus sample values if you allow them) and proposes terms, warnings, metrics and queries. Everything it proposes is checked against the schema and saved as a draft for you to review.
draft.noAi: No AI Connection service exists yet. Create one under API Generation & Connections › AI (type AI Connection), then come back here.
draft.tablesHint: Leave empty to send the whole model ({{count}} tables).
draft.running: Asking the model… reading the schema can take a minute on a large database.
draft.result: The model proposed {{proposed}} entries: {{created}} saved as drafts, {{rejected}} rejected.
draft.modelHint: Overrides the connection’s default model for this draft. Required if the connection has no default model.
draft.tablesRequiredHint: This service exposes {{count}} tables. Pick the ones worth describing, at most {{max}} per draft; the rest are not scanned.
draft.tooManyTables: Pick at most {{max}} tables per draft.
draft.tablesUnknownHint: The table list could not be loaded. Type the tables to describe, at most {{max}}.
draft.includeSamples: Send sample rows to the model
draft.includeSamplesHint: Sample rows and value lists are data from your database. Off: the model sees no row values, only names, types and counts.
draft.aiForbidden: You don’t have access to the list of AI Connection services, so there is nothing to draft with. Ask an administrator.
draft.aiFailed: The AI Connection services could not be loaded. Close this and try again.

import.title: Import catalog JSON
import.hint: Paste an export document or choose a file. Entries are matched by kind and name: new ones are created as drafts, existing ones are updated.
import.approve: Approve entries the document marks approved (each is checked against the schema first)
import.invalid: That is not an export document. Expected {"entries": [...]} as produced by Export JSON.
import.result: Import finished: {{created}} created, {{updated}} updated, {{unchanged}} unchanged, {{approved}} approved, {{failed}} failed.
import.tooLarge: That file is larger than {{max}} MB. Split the catalog or paste the part you need.

validation.name: Name is required.
validation.mapValueField: A mapped value needs a field.
validation.mapTable: Pick the table this term maps to.
validation.mapValue: Enter the value this term maps to.
validation.targetTable: Applies-to {{n}} needs a table (or remove it).
validation.question: Question is required.
validation.limit: Limit must be a whole number from 1 to 1000.
validation.paramName: Param "{{name}}" must start with a letter or _ and use only letters, digits and _.

noAccess.title: You don’t have access to the semantic catalog
noAccess.description: Your role cannot read the catalog for this service. Ask an administrator for access to system/semantic.

picker.more: {{count}} more match. Keep typing to narrow the list.
picker.freeText: The table list could not be loaded; type the table name.

approveAll.title: Approve {{count}} drafts?
approveAll.message: Each of the {{count}} drafts waiting for review is checked against the schema and approved, one at a time. Approved entries reach agents right away. Drafts that fail the check stay drafts and show why.
